messages.subject: CNV Visualization in IGV
parts:
Hallo Yuchao,

I have a question regarding the R script for the IGV vizualization that you uploaded some times ago. I didn't get the part where a matrix will be created from a tumorname_lookup.txt. Could you maybe give me some explanation regarding this step? Thank you in advance and I really enjoy using CODEX for my analysis!

Best regards,
Sri Dewi

messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: CNV Visualization in IGV
parts:
Hi Sri,

Thanks for your interest in CODEX. The script I uploaded a while ago was to generate seg files to be loaded into IGV for visualization. Basically it parses the combined CNV calls from all chromosomes in all samples into one text file for one sample. The code is only for demo — I am sure you can parse this very easily too. With this said, I think the tumorsample_lookup.txt contains all the tumor names so for each tumor sample, I searched for its called CNVs and save them as a text file for that specific sample.

Hope that this clarifies,
Yuchao
